class.name: SimulationServer
class.brief_description: The state of the world the whole simulation shares, and its one clock.
class.description: Owns the environment's time of day, date, location, cloud cover and air temperature, works the light level out of them ([code]Global.fLuminance[/code], [code]cSun[/code] in [code]sun.cpp[/code]) and announces their changes by signals; and runs the one clock of the simulation ([code]Timer::UpdateTimers()[/code], [code]Timer.cpp:70-92[/code]): the physics, the events, the drivers and the time of day all advance by the same seconds, read here. The caches and the game's data are [GameDataServer]'s.

method.name: date_set
method.description: The day the time of day belongs to. A day or a month past its end carries over (the 32nd of January is the 1st of February). Emits [signal date_changed] on a change; the clock rolls the date itself at midnight.

method.name: environment_reset
method.description: The time of day, the date, the location, the cloud cover and the temperature back to their defaults - what an environment starts from before its scene sets its own ([code]MaszynaEnvironmentNode[/code]).

method.name: simulation_get_current_speed
method.description: The speed the clock runs at now, on its way to [member simulation_speed]: like a tape's motor, it gets most of the way there in the Project Setting [code]maszyna/simulation/speed_change_time[/code].

method.name: simulation_is_paused
method.description: Whether the world is paused, see [method simulation_pause].

method.name: simulation_pause
method.description: Stops the world while something covers it - a loading screen, the spinner of "Exit to menu". Emits [signal simulation_paused] if it was running. [RailVehicleServer] stops stepping the vehicles, the environment holds its weather and the sound systems hold the world's voices; the scene tree itself keeps running, so a scenery still loads and vehicles still take their places.

method.name: simulation_reset_speed
method.description: The wall clock's speed, at once rather than over the speed change time - a scenery starts at it, and the menu is heard at it.

method.name: simulation_unpause
method.description: Starts the world again after [method simulation_pause]. Emits [signal simulation_unpaused] if it was paused.

members.member: Degrees Celsius; the sun's refraction depends on it.
0-1, the weather's; full cover dims the daylight by 0.65 ([code]simulationenvironment.cpp:163[/code]).

The language of the game's strings, named as its catalogue in the game's [code]lang/[/code] ([code]"pl"[/code] for [code]lang/pl.po[/code]); [code]"en"[/code] is the original's own strings, untranslated. Kept in the user settings; [MaszynaTranslationServer] loads the catalogue.
Where the sun is seen from, decimal degrees north. The original's is a fixed 52 N ([code]sun.cpp:13[/code]).

How bright the scene is, 0-1: daylight from the refracted altitude of the sun ([code]cSun::move()[/code], [code]refract()[/code], [code]sun.cpp:104-240[/code]), ramped between the project settings [code]maszyna/lights/night_altitude[/code] and [code]day_altitude[/code], dimmed by [member cloud_cover]. Worked out when a minute passes and when anything it depends on is set; [signal light_level_changed] when it moves.
Decimal degrees east. The original's is a fixed 19 E ([code]sun.cpp:13[/code]).
Hours since midnight. Set, it jumps; running, it advances with the simulation and carries the date past midnight.
Hours the time of day is ahead of UTC.
The time of day and the date follow the system's clock instead of the simulation's.

signal.name: date_changed
signal.description: The date was set, or the clock passed midnight.

signal.name: language_changed
signal.description: [member language] was set to another language.

signal.name: simulation_current_speed_changed
signal.description: The speed the clock runs at changed - every frame while it goes to the one set.

signal.name: simulation_paused
signal.description: Emitted by [method simulation_pause] when the world stops.

signal.name: simulation_unpaused
signal.description: Emitted by [method simulation_unpause] when the world starts again.

signal.name: time_of_day_changed
signal.description: A minute passed, or the time of day was set.

signal.name: time_of_day_hour_changed
signal.description: An hour passed, or the time of day was set to another hour.
